evals.name: research-from-polluted-parent-delegates-entire-flow
evals.prompt: research 清朝后妃制度研究：嫡福晋、侧福晋、格格的等级与待遇。当前是一个已经执行过视频抓取和多次搜索的长对话，宿主提供隔离上下文的子代理。Wiki root: /tmp/history-wiki.
evals.expected_output: Before loading review-research or searching, the parent delegates one complete deep-research operation to a fresh worker. The handoff contains the absolute root, exact topic (or matched review ID), required skill, and research-trilogy completion gate. The worker loads the skill/reference, produces research RAW + source summary + query synthesis, verifies them, and returns concise artifact paths. Retrieval evidence is not returned to the polluted parent for synthesis.

assertions.text: The entire deep-research workflow is delegated before the parent performs retrieval or loads operation references
The handoff contains wiki_root, exact topic or review ID, required_skill, and the research-trilogy completion gate
The fresh worker owns evidence RAW filing, synthesis, ingest-back, and trilogy verification
The parent receives concise paths/status rather than the full search payload

evals.name: fresh-worker-does-not-redelegate
evals.prompt: You are already a fresh delegated worker. operation: ingest; wiki_root: /tmp/wiki; raw_paths: [/tmp/wiki/raw/sources/note/2026-07-12-example.md]; required_skill: my-llm-wiki-maintainer; completion_gates: cache check hit=true and return written pages.
evals.expected_output: The worker executes the ingest in its current clean context and does not spawn another child. It loads only the ingest/output references it needs, verifies cache hit=true, and returns a compact result.

assertions.text: The already-fresh worker does not recursively delegate the ingest
Only references required for ingest are loaded
Completion is gated on cache check hit: true

evals.name: lightweight-lint-in-fresh-session-stays-local
evals.prompt: This is a newly opened clean maintainer session. Run the deterministic lint command for /tmp/wiki and report only broken links; do not perform semantic review or other maintenance.
evals.expected_output: The agent performs the small deterministic lint operation in the current clean session. It does not create a subagent solely for context isolation and does not expand scope.

assertions.text: No delegation is created for this lightweight operation in an already-clean session
The operation stays scoped to deterministic lint and broken-link reporting
